rows: Black box first: 20 of 20 on the Node service and on the Rust binary. Interleaved start, idle and refusal measurements (`docs/audits/benchmarks/capture-listener-bench.py`, record `capture-listener-node-vs-rust.json`): start 1,022.7 ms to 14.2 ms, idle RSS 137,788 KB to 6,572 KB, refusal p50 0.659 ms to 0.520 ms, release binary 4,191,112 B. Removed with it: `libraries/socks5-forward`, `libraries/rate-limit`, `tooling/service-bundle`, `tooling/cli-bundle`, the capture exception in the raw-Playwright guard and the default entrypoints of the span-coverage rule. Decision: ship; the VM check (health, no Node process, BetterStack lines) follows the pipeline deploy.
